waypoints.name: North Fork Sauk Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Darrington, drive the Mountain Loop Highway south about 16 miles and turn left (east) onto FS Road 49, the North Fork Sauk Road. Follow it about 6.4 miles to the North Fork Sauk Trailhead at the road end near 2,100 ft; the road is rough and a high-clearance vehicle helps. A Northwest Forest Pass is required to park.

waypoints.name: Painted Mountain
waypoints.directions: About 100 yards up the North Fork Sauk Trail, take the old lookout trail branching left and switchback about a mile through forest to the old lookout site near 3,100 ft. Above it a steep, unmaintained climbers' path goes almost straight uphill, over a short cliff band that needs class 3 scrambling, into meadows and up the south ridge to Painted Mountain's summit.

waypoints.name: Black Mountain
waypoints.directions: Descend Painted's northeast ridge to a saddle and continue over Magenta Peak. The row of gendarmes east of Magenta forces you off the crest onto steep heather, a mossy downclimb and loose gullies below it; keep heading east to Black Mountain and finish on its short, exposed class 3-4 summit block.
